notes_for_editor: The FFLA list (firelookout.org) gives a 'Dead Mountain' in Lane County at 43.44757, -122.15302 as Firefinder/Abandoned, roughly 40 km from the record point (43.77435, -122.40609). The record point fits the 1953 NGS description (3 miles NE of Oakridge), so the record was not changed; the FFLA coordinates may be for the same lookout. The Forest Lookouts page carries an unexplained 'Removed' label. The 1904 'camp' entry is unexplained. The 1940 abandonment date is decade only. No design or height is in the sources read. Cascadia Wildlands is about a forest project, not the lookout.
